```artifact
Feature: Alarms and Temperature Monitoring

  Scenario: Battery Failure Alarm Priority
    Given the system is initialized
    When a battery failure occurs
    Then the "battery failure" alarm is triggered with high priority

  Scenario: Temperature Sensor Sensing
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower motor is read
    Then the temperature value is displayed in the GUI
    And the temperature of the blower power mgmt system is read
    And the temperature value is displayed in the GUI
    And the temperature of the battery cell is read
    And the temperature value is displayed in the GUI

  Scenario: Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower motor is above the threshold
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    And the alarm priority is high

  Scenario: Blower Power System Temperature Too High Alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower power mgmt system is above the threshold
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    And the alarm priority is high
    And a safety action is automatically invoked

  Scenario: Battery Temperature Too High Alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the battery cell is above the threshold
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm is triggered
    And the alarm priority is high
    And a safety action is automatically invoked

  Scenario Outline: Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm with Different Thresholds
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower motor is <threshold>
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm is <expected>
    And the alarm priority is high

    Examples:
      | threshold | expected |
      | 99        | not triggered |
      | 100       | triggered   |
      | 101       | triggered   |

  Scenario Outline: Blower Power System Temperature Too High Alarm with Different Thresholds
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower power mgmt system is <threshold>
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm is <expected>
    And the alarm priority is high
    And a safety action is automatically invoked

    Examples:
      | threshold | expected |
      | 149       | not triggered |
      | 150       | triggered   |
      | 151       | triggered   |

  Scenario Outline: Battery Temperature Too High Alarm with Different Thresholds
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the battery cell is <threshold>
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm is <expected>
    And the alarm priority is high
    And a safety action is automatically invoked

    Examples:
      | threshold | expected |
      | 199       | not triggered |
      | 200       | triggered   |
      | 201       | triggered   |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid Temperature Inputs
    Given the system is initialized
    When an invalid temperature input is provided (e.g., <input>)
    Then an error message is displayed
    And the system remains in a safe state

    Examples:
      | input     |
      | -10       |
      | "abc"     |
      | 1000      |
```
